infrastructure.description: Zscaler ThreatLabz states that it analyzed WageMole as an associated campaign perpetrated by the same threat group behind the Contagious Interview activity it monitored. Its campaign overview says personal data stolen through Contagious Interview can be used to prepare fake identities and secure remote work in WageMole. The employment workflow then includes fabricated or altered identity material, interview study guides, role-specific resumes, job-platform automation, colleague-assisted interviews, and post-hire collaboration.
